record.name: WooCommerce
record.one_liner: An open-source e-commerce platform built on WordPress for managing online stores and products.
record.access_note: WooCommerce is an open-source WordPress plugin; API credentials are generated directly in the WordPress dashboard.
record.api_note: The REST API covers core e-commerce objects including products, orders, customers, and inventory.

evidence.quote: Most integrations require you to generate API keys in WooCommerce and enter them in the external service
This documentation is about the free, core WooCommerce plugin
WooCommerce (WC) 2.6+ is fully integrated with the WordPress REST API. This allows WC data to be created, read, updated, and dele
The MCP integration uses a multi-layered architecture to bridge between MCP clients and WordPress
